title: Detailed headphones
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Headband -->
  <path d="M20 55 Q20 15 50 15 Q80 15 80 55" fill="none" stroke="#4FC3F7" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Headband highlight -->
  <path d="M26 50 Q26 22 50 22 Q74 22 74 50" fill="none" stroke="#81D4FA" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Headband inner padding -->
  <path d="M32 52 Q32 30 50 30 Q68 30 68 52" fill="none" stroke="#29B6F6" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Left ear cup outer -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="62" rx="16" ry="20" fill="#FF7043"/>
  <!-- Left ear cup inner -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="62" rx="10" ry="14" fill="#FFAB91"/>
  <!-- Left ear cup cushion -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="62" rx="7" ry="11" fill="#FF8A65"/>
  <!-- Right ear cup outer -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="62" rx="16" ry="20" fill="#FF7043"/>
  <!-- Right ear cup inner -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="62" rx="10" ry="14" fill="#FFAB91"/>
  <!-- Right ear cup cushion -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="62" rx="7" ry="11" fill="#FF8A65"/>
  <!-- Left hinge -->
  <rect x="17" y="42" width="10" height="8" rx="3" fill="#B0BEC5"/>
  <!-- Right hinge -->
  <rect x="73" y="42" width="10" height="8" rx="3" fill="#B0BEC5"/>
  <!-- Left slider -->
  <rect x="20" y="36" width="4" height="10" rx="2" fill="#90A4AE"/>
  <!-- Right slider -->
  <rect x="76" y="36" width="4" height="10" rx="2" fill="#90A4AE"/>
  <!-- Left ear cup accent ring -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="62" rx="13" ry="17" fill="none" stroke="#FFAB91" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Right ear cup accent ring -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="62" rx="13" ry="17" fill="none" stroke="#FFAB91" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Cable jack (left side) -->
  <rect x="10" y="72" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#B0BEC5"/>
  <rect x="11" y="80" width="4" height="8" rx="1" fill="#90A4AE"/>
  <!-- Detail dots on ear cups -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#FFE0B2"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#FFE0B2"/>
  <circle cx="18" cy="66" r="1.5" fill="#FFE0B2"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="66" r="1.5" fill="#FFE0B2"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#FFE0B2"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#FFE0B2"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="66" r="1.5" fill="#FFE0B2"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="66" r="1.5" fill="#FFE0B2"/>
  <!-- Small star accent on left cup -->
  <polygon points="22,52 23,55 26,55 24,57 25,60 22,58 19,60 20,57 18,55 21,55" fill="#FFF176"/>
  <!-- Small star accent on right cup -->
  <polygon points="78,52 79,55 82,55 80,57 81,60 78,58 75,60 76,57 74,55 77,55" fill="#FFF176"/>
</svg>
